summary: Skier Edwin LaMair caught in an avalanche in the East Vail Chutes (between Vail Pass and Vail ski area) and nearly fully buried; dug out by his brother, who captured the rescue on GoPro; knee injury.
location: East Vail Chutes (between Vail Pass and Vail ski area)
notes: Brother rescue, no SAR agency response; avalanche danger 'Considerable' after 18 in of new snow over 4 days. Inserted run 807 (VMRG archives chunk).
